This matches misalignment references where 2x dominates on ch0/ch2 (e.g., 0.01566/0.01504, 0.01499/0.01175, 0.00611/0.00480) with low 1x, unlike normal references where 2x on ch0/ch2 is typically 0.0004-0.0064. 3x remains low, crest ~4.6-6.9 and kurtosis ~3.1-4.0 similar to normal/misalignment. Limitation: radial-only short recording, 2x elevation is moderate and overlaps upper normal range, so cannot fully exclude normal variability.
